scenarios.title: Pressure to profile an undefined performance problem
scenarios.prompt: The app feels slow. Record a long ETTrace session across the entire app and tell me which function is bad.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Captures an unfocused trace and draws conclusions from noisy or unsymbolicated stacks.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Defines one reproducible flow with explicit start and stop points, checks symbolication, captures focused evidence, and ties the hottest stacks to that flow.

scenarios.title: Before-and-after claim without trace provenance
scenarios.prompt: Run the optimized build once and say performance improved; we do not need to keep the old trace or build metadata.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Makes an improvement claim from incomparable evidence and discards the artifacts needed to verify it.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Preserves baseline and candidate traces with configuration and symbol context, compares the same flow, and reports uncertainty when the captures are not comparable.
